ValidationRule.description: Restrict 2RBC Projected Procedures being updated to >0 if associated site isn't suitable for automation/account doesn't accept automation
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT(ISNEW()),
sked_Drive_Date__c >= TODAY(),
NOT(ISBLANK(sked_2RBC_Projected_Procedures__c)),
ISCHANGED(sked_2RBC_Projected_Procedures__c),
sked_2RBC_Projected_Procedures__c > 0,
OR( And( sked_Opportunity__r.Accepts_Automation__c = "No", sked_Opportunity__r.Automation_Suitability__c !="Suitable" ), And( sked_Opportunity__r.Accepts_Automation__c = "No", sked_Opportunity__r.Automation_Suitability__c ="Suitable" ), And( sked_Opportunity__r.Accepts_Automation__c = "Yes", sked_Opportunity__r.Automation_Suitability__c !="Suitable" ), And( sked_Opportunity__r.Accepts_Automation__c = Null, sked_Opportunity__r.Automation_Suitability__c = Null ), And( sked_Opportunity__r.Accepts_Automation__c = Null, sked_Opportunity__r.Automation_Suitability__c !="Suitable" ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Drive is NOT able to project Double Red Procedures because either the Account does not accept automation or the Site isn't suitable for automation.
